```{r setup, include = knitr::is_html_output(), error = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Save this file in the experiment's analysis/ folder before knitting.
# Quick route straight from .wsp files -- for data not (yet) in the lab DB.
# Builds the same `dat` / `pops` shape (mouse_id, condition, group) as the
# lab-DB template, so plot chunks can move between the two.

####DO NOT CHANGE----
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.path = paste0("output/", xfun::sans_ext(knitr::current_input()), "/figs/", Sys.Date(), "/"),
  dev = "png",
  dpi = 300,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 10,
  # hides code in pdf file
  echo = knitr::is_html_output()
)
####----

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(JanisHelpers)

# group colours, used by plot_box() / plot_population() / plot_paired()
options(JanisHelpers.group_colors = c(treated = "#00BFC4", control = "#F8766D"))

dat <- local({
  group_levels <- c("treated", "control")
  meta <- meta_read(here("data", "<experiment folder>", "meta", "meta_<experiment>.xlsx"))
  calc_meta <- meta_clean(meta)
  subjects <- meta$meta |>
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = group_levels))

  overview <- facs_read_wsp(
    path = here("data", "<experiment folder>", "raw", "FACS", "<overview>.wsp"),
    group = "Samples",
    keywords = c("mouse_ID", "tissue")
  )$data |>
    facs_select_populations(populations = c("live_CD45+", "CD4+", "CD8+")) |>
    facs_calc_pct_of(ref_pop = "live_CD45+") |>
    facs_calc_count_per_g(
      meta = calc_meta,
      vol_total = "total_vol",
      vol_stained = "ov_vol",
      vol_resuspended = "resuspended_vol",
      vol_measured = "measured_vol",
      organ_piece_weight = "facs_weight"
    ) |>
    meta_annotate(select(subjects, mouse_ID, group)) |>
    # DB column names, so chunks match the lab-DB template; for a restim
    # panel also rename the keyword column: condition = restimulation
    rename(mouse_id = mouse_ID)

  list(
    meta = rename(subjects, mouse_id = mouse_ID),
    overview = overview
  )
})

# Derived data goes back into dat, e.g. dat$restim_fc <- ...

# Population selections used in the plots
pops <- list(
  # t_cells = c("CD4+", "CD8+")
)
```

# Overview

```{r overview}
dat$meta |>
  count(group, sex)
```
